zh.title: 身分與權限：登入之後能做什麼？
zh.summary: 成功登入只建立身分的某種證據。授權要再決定這個主體能對哪些資源執行哪些動作。
objectives: 分開驗證 authentication 與 authorization。
用權限矩陣檢查最小權限與預設拒絕。

sections.heading: 身分不是萬用通行證
paragraphs: Authentication 回答「你以什麼身分通過驗證」，authorization 回答「這個身分能做什麼」。同一個帳號可以讀取自己的報告，卻沒有修改別人報告或管理系統的權限。
權限提升表示取得原先沒有的較高能力。判斷時要比較提升前後的有效權限與動作證據，不能只因為命令成功或頁面顯示「admin」就宣稱已控制整個系統。

sections.heading: 用最小權限縮小影響範圍
paragraphs: 最小權限讓主體只取得工作所需的能力；預設拒絕讓未明確允許的請求被拒絕。把主體、資源與動作列成矩陣，可避免「有登入就全部允許」這類模糊規則。
驗證應同時包含可做與不可做的動作。若讀者角色能讀報告卻不能刪除，兩個結果都要確認。日常帳號與管理工作分離，可以減少錯誤或帳號遭濫用時的影響。

example.title: 例子：報告讀者與維護者
example.scenario: 合成系統有 reader 和 maintainer 兩個角色。reader 應只能讀自己的報告；maintainer 能更新報告，但不能變更帳號角色。
example.reasoning: 權限可拆成讀、寫、角色管理三個動作。維護報告的需要不會自動帶來帳號管理能力。每個判斷都應在可信的伺服端執行。
example.conclusion: 權限矩陣必須明列拒絕項目，並驗證它們。

lab.title: 紙上練習：補完權限矩陣
lab.environment: 使用本文虛構角色，不變更實際帳號。
steps: 列出 reader、maintainer 與三個動作。
按例子填入允許或拒絕，再加入「reader 讀別人的報告」。
寫出一個正向檢查與一個拒絕檢查。
lab.expected: reader 的寫入與角色管理被拒絕；maintainer 的角色管理也被拒絕；reader 不能讀他人的報告。
lab.check: 為何隱藏「刪除」按鈕不能取代伺服端授權？
lab.cleanup: 保存矩陣即可；沒有權限變更需要回復。

en.title: Identity and privilege: what can you do after login?
en.summary: A successful login establishes evidence about identity. Authorization separately determines which actions that principal may perform on which resources.
objectives: Check least privilege and default denial with a permission matrix.

sections.heading: Identity is not universal permission
paragraphs: Authentication concerns the identity established by verification. Authorization concerns what that identity may do. An account may read its own report without permission to edit another person’s report or administer the system.

Privilege escalation involves gaining higher capabilities than previously held. Compare effective permissions and action evidence before and after; a successful command or a page displaying “admin” does not establish control of an entire system.

sections.heading: Use least privilege to limit impact
paragraphs: Least privilege gives a principal only the capabilities needed for its task. Default denial rejects requests that are not explicitly allowed. A matrix of principals, resources and actions avoids vague rules such as allowing everything after login.

Verification needs allowed and denied actions. If a reader can read reports but cannot delete them, confirm both outcomes. Separating everyday accounts from administration limits the impact of mistakes or account misuse.

example.title: Example: report readers and maintainers
example.scenario: A synthetic system has reader and maintainer roles. A reader may read only their own report. A maintainer may update reports but not change account roles.
example.reasoning: Split the policy into read, write and role-management actions. Maintaining reports does not automatically require account administration. Enforce each decision at a trusted server boundary.
example.conclusion: The matrix must include denied actions and verify them.

lab.title: Tabletop exercise: complete a permission matrix
lab.environment: Use the fictional roles without changing real accounts.
steps: List reader, maintainer and the three actions.
Fill allow or deny using the example, then add “reader reads someone else’s report.”
Write one positive check and one denial check.
lab.expected: Reader writes and role changes are denied. Maintainer role changes are also denied. A reader cannot read someone else’s report.
lab.check: Why does hiding a Delete button not replace server-side authorization?
lab.cleanup: Save the matrix; no permission changes require restoration.

zh.prompt: 登入成功後，是否自動有權讀取所有報告？
options: 否，仍要檢查資源與動作的授權
否，登入後不能讀任何資料
rationales: 身分與權限是不同問題。
每個資源動作都須符合政策。
知道識別碼不等於有權限。
明確授權的讀取仍應允許。

en.prompt: Does successful login automatically allow reading all reports?
options: No; resource and action authorization still apply
Yes, if the report ID is known
No; login never permits reading data
rationales: Identity and permission are distinct questions.
Each resource action must satisfy policy.
Knowing an identifier does not grant access.
Explicitly authorized reads should still work.

zh.prompt: 只驗證 reader 能讀資料，還缺哪項重要檢查？
options: reader 無法執行未授權寫入
所有角色都改成管理員
rationales: 拒絕檢查確認權限邊界有效。
擴大權限違反本題的最小權限目標。

en.prompt: After verifying that a reader can read data, which important check is missing?
options: The reader cannot perform unauthorized writes
rationales: Titles do not test access controls.
Denial checks verify the permission boundary.
Expanding privileges contradicts the least-privilege goal.
